description: Autoroutes et voies rapides (tracé simplifié) en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [ Situation 2012 ] Ce jeu de données contient l'ensemble des autoroutes et voies rapides simplifiées par généralisation. Les discontinuités et arc pendants ont été corrigés Certains tronçons ont été allongés pour assurer une continuité visuelle. Consulter la métadonnée. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Aménagement du territoire. Its keywords are Routes, Autoroutes, Déplacements, Voiture. The portal shows 41 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
